instruction: Review payroll correction batch PC-08 for employee E-551 using the available sources. Determine the total net pay correction, the corresponding tax adjustment, which corrections are eligible and approved, which entries should be excluded or denied, and whether additional approval is required. Use only PC-08 entries for employee E-551. Exclude entries from prior batches, different employees, and duplicate submissions. Apply the payroll correction policy for eligible correction types and the marginal tax rate for E-551's pay grade. Return only a JSON object with these fields: net_correction_amount, tax_adjustment, approved_corrections, excluded_entries, denied_corrections, approval_required. net_correction_amount must be the total eligible gross pay correction for E-551 before any tax adjustment (i.e. the sum of all approved net_change amounts). tax_adjustment must be the additional tax withheld on taxable correction types (overtime and bonus only) using E-551's marginal rate. approved_corrections must be an array of short snake_case labels for correction entries that are valid and approved. excluded_entries must be an array of short snake_case labels for entries excluded from processing (prior batch, wrong employee, or duplicate). denied_corrections must be an array of short snake_case labels for entries that are in scope but are rejected due to policy ineligibility. approval_required must be a boolean indicating whether Payroll Director sign-off is needed. Do not include explanation outside the JSON.

evaluation_criteria.scoring_notes: Eligible E-551 PC-08 entries: C1(360), C2(500), C3(270), C4(340). Exclude: N1(prior batch PC-07), C5(duplicate of C1), C6(different employee E-662). No denied_corrections (all in-scope entries are approved types). Net correction: 360+500+270+340=1470. Taxable portion (overtime+bonus only): C1(360)+C2(500)+C3(270)=1130. Expense reimbursement C4(340) is tax-free. Tax adjustment: 1130×0.22=248.60 (E-551 is L4, marginal rate 22%). approval_required=true because net_correction 1470 > 1000 threshold.
